assistant_message.content: Great! Let me take a look at the portal now and find where to change your retirement contribution type.

I can see exactly where to do this. You're currently on the right page — here are the steps:

**How to Change Your Contribution from Pretax (Traditional) to Roth:**

1. You are already on the **Retirement Services** page for *Apartment Rental Assistance II Inc 401(k) Plan*.
2. Click the **"Contributions"** tab in the top navigation (it's the second tab, right after "Summary").
3. Scroll down slightly until you see the **"Contributions"** section showing your current split:
   - **Pretax: 3%**
   - **Roth: 0%**
4. Click the **"Edit"** button on the right side of that Contributions section.
5. In the edit screen, you can **reduce your Pretax percentage to 0%** and **increase your Roth percentage to 3%** (or whatever amount you prefer) to switch entirely to Roth contributions.
6. Save/confirm your changes.

> **Note:** This is a **401(k) plan**, not a traditional or Roth IRA — it's an employer-sponsored plan. The "Pretax" option is the traditional pre-tax 401(k), and "Roth" is the Roth 401(k). Changing this will affect **future contributions only** — your existing $370.85 balance will remain in the pre-tax bucket unless you do a separate in-plan Roth conversion (if your plan allows it).

There is also a **"Roth analysis tool"** button just below the Contributions section — that can help you compare the two options before making your decision.
